nodes.label: ABench-Physics: Physics Reasoning Benchmark
nodes.author: Yiming Zhang, Yingfan Ma, et al.
nodes.rationale: Novel benchmark for evaluating LLM physical reasoning with two components: static high-difficulty problems (Phy_A) and dynamic parameterized problems (Phy_B) with automatic variation engine.

nodes.label: Phy_A: Static Physics Problems
nodes.rationale: Fixed set of 400 graduate-level or Olympiad-level physics problems providing stable baseline for model performance evaluation.

nodes.label: Phy_B: Dynamic Physics Problems
nodes.rationale: 100 parameterized physics problems with automatic variation engine that alters numerical constants to test model generalization and prevent memorization.

nodes.label: Numerical Evaluation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Strict 1% relative error tolerance for numerical answers; requires correct answers on all dynamic variants for credit; includes LaTeX-based evaluation function.

nodes.label: Memorization vs. Reasoning Detection
nodes.rationale: Dynamic evaluation paradigm designed to distinguish genuine physical reasoning from pattern memorization by testing robustness to numerical perturbations.

nodes.label: Data Contamination Risk in Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Problem where models achieve high scores by retrieving memorized answers rather than genuine reasoning; motivates need for dynamic evaluation paradigms.

nodes.label: LLM Physics Reasoning Gap
nodes.rationale: Substantial performance gaps in physics reasoning even for state-of-the-art models; Gemini 2.5 Pro achieves only 43% on static problems with 22.5% average drop on dynamic variants.

nodes.label: UGPhysics: Undergraduate Physics Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Prior physics reasoning benchmark with university-level problems; ABench-Physics extends with higher difficulty and dynamic evaluation.

nodes.label: PHYSICS Dataset: Large-Scale Physics Problems
nodes.rationale: Large-scale corpus of physics problems with training/test splits; related work on scale and trainability of physics reasoning evaluation.
